trust_boundaries.name: TB-1 RANDAO mixes (StatePatch.randao_mixes)
trust_boundaries.assumption: Host-supplied RANDAO values for future epochs are accepted with only plausibility checks; no Merkle proof binds them to on-chain state.
trust_boundaries.evidence: UNTRUSTED — host-supplied, no Merkle proof. Affects entire committee assignment for all epochs covered by the patch (get_seed()).

trust_boundaries.name: TB-2 Validator exits (StatePatch.validator_exits)
trust_boundaries.assumption: Host-supplied exit epochs are validated for churn-limit plausibility only; 'once only' and ordering checks use assert!() not Result<>.
trust_boundaries.evidence: PARTIALLY VALIDATED — churn-limit plausibility only. Host can understate/overstate exits within churn tolerance.

trust_boundaries.name: TB-3 BLS public keys (public_keys Vec in StateInput)
trust_boundaries.assumption: Public keys are matched byte-for-byte against compressed multiproof chunks; PublicKey::deserialize can panic on invalid input.
trust_boundaries.evidence: UNTRUSTED — host-supplied. deserialize() called without error recovery (conversions.rs:73).

trust_boundaries.name: TB-4 SSZ multiproof descriptor/data (StateInput multiproofs)
trust_boundaries.assumption: The verified chain finalized_checkpoint.root -> beacon_block.state_root -> beacon_state.validators_root -> per-validator fields anchors all proven state; multiproof data length is not pre-validated before index arithmetic.
trust_boundaries.evidence: descriptor-driven stack algorithm; no explicit check that data.len() == node_count * CHUNK_SIZE (multiproof.rs:~209).

candidates.title: Unproven RANDAO enables adversarial committee manipulation
candidates.summary: Unproven RANDAO enables adversarial committee manipulation. StatePatch.randao_mixes values are host-supplied and accepted without any Merkle proof; get_seed() uses them to compute the shuffling seed, letting an adversarial host shift committee assignments to undermine the BLS threshold check. Soundness. PoC: algorithmic sketch, trigger path contains no hidden guards. (ssz_state_reader.rs:304-309, state_reader.rs:60-74)

candidates.title: Over-permissive churn budget in validate_state_patches
candidates.summary: Over-permissive churn budget in validate_state_patches. The churn budget is get_balance_churn_limit() * 2 ('seems reasonable'); an adversarial host can inject validator exits that pass this check but would be invalid on-chain, deflating the quorum denominator. Soundness (partial). (ssz_state_reader.rs:205-207)

extensions.system_description: ZKasper: a RISC Zero zkVM guest that proves Ethereum Casper FFG finality. The host prepares SSZ Merkle multiproofs of beacon state fields plus uncompressed BLS public keys plus state patches; the guest verifies those proofs inside the zkVM, reconstructs validator committees via RANDAO-based shuffle, verifies BLS aggregate signatures over attestations, applies Casper FFG state-transition rules, and commits (pre_state, post_state) as the public journal.
trust_roots: consensus_state.finalized_checkpoint.root — the only externally-anchored root; everything chains from it
RISC Zero journal commitment: only pre_state and post_state ABI-encoded bytes are public outputs
unverified_data: StatePatch.randao_mixes: accepted with only plausibility checks; no Merkle proof of RANDAO values
StatePatch.validator_exits: validated for churn-limit plausibility but 'once only' and ordering checks use assert!() not Result<>
public_keys Vec: matched against compressed chunks in proof but PublicKey::deserialize can panic on invalid input

threat_model_notes: Replay: consensus_state.finalized_checkpoint is the chain-anchoring root; BLS signing domain includes genesis_validators_root and fork version — replay resistance across chains and forks.
RANDAO manipulation: RANDAO is unproven; host supplies future-epoch RANDAO without on-chain proof. Single largest trust gap.
Downgrade: Config.min_version / max_version restrict fork to Electra only — downgrade resistance present.
CSPRNG: No keygen or nonce generation in guest code; all randomness comes from RANDAO.
Sanitized checkpoints: trusted_checkpoint comes from pre-existing ConsensusState committed in the journal; attacker cannot forge it without breaking the zkVM proof binding.
